anomalies.description: A group of individuals engages in mutual physical combat, with multiple people striking, grappling, and surrounding others on the ground; actions include punching, kicking, and pulling, with participants actively exchanging blows and shifting positions throughout the sequence.

At least one individual is on the ground or bent over while multiple others strike or stomp on them, indicating a helpless victim being attacked by a group; this overlaps with the broader fighting but includes clear asymmetrical aggression toward a subdued person.

After the initial melee subsides, one individual is seen lying on the ground while others stand over or move away; a person in light clothing appears to kick or strike the prone individual, indicating targeted attack on a helpless victim.

The scene transitions to broader unrest: large groups of people moving aggressively, some shirtless, throwing objects (e.g., f14 shows a person mid-throw), and chaotic movement across the street, consistent with collective violent unrest beyond a single brawl.

Multiple police officers (some on foot, some mounted) engage in physical struggle with a person on the ground; the individual is restrained, pinned, and appears to be resisting while officers apply force to subdue them.

After being brought to the ground, the individual remains prone while multiple officers continue to apply pressure and control techniques, including kneeling on or near the torso/neck area, suggesting potential excessive force against a subdued person.

A large crowd is engaged in violent unrest, with visible pushing, shoving, and chaotic movement; smoke or dust rises in the background, and individuals are seen running and falling. A group of people in high-visibility yellow vests (likely security or police) are positioned near the center-right, appearing to be confronting or attempting to control the crowd. The density and dynamic motion suggest collective violent behavior beyond a peaceful gathering.

In frames f7–f10, multiple individuals in the central-left area are observed in close physical contact with aggressive postures: one person appears to be thrown or pushed to the ground (visible at f8), while others grapple or strike. This indicates mutual physical combat among small groups within the larger riot.

A large crowd is engaged in chaotic, dynamic movement with visible pushing and shoving; a group of individuals in high-visibility yellow vests (likely security or police) are actively intervening, forming lines and attempting to control the crowd. Smoke or dust is present in the background, and the overall scene shows signs of collective violent unrest rather than a peaceful gathering.

In frames f4–f11, multiple small clusters within the crowd show clear mutual physical combat: individuals are seen grappling, punching, and wrestling, with others surrounding and participating. These localized fights occur amid the broader rioting activity.

A large crowd of civilians is engaged in a violent confrontation with a group of police officers wearing high-visibility yellow vests. Officers are seen advancing, forming lines, and appearing to push or clash with the crowd; some individuals in the crowd are throwing objects or moving aggressively toward police. Smoke or dust is visible in the background, suggesting use of crowd-control measures. The interaction is dynamic and escalatory across the sequence.

A large crowd of civilians is gathered in an open urban area, facing a line of individuals in bright yellow high-visibility vests (likely security or police). There is visible movement and tension: some individuals in yellow vests are crouching or moving dynamically, while parts of the crowd appear agitated, with some people running or shifting rapidly. Smoke or dust is present in the background near the center, suggesting possible use of crowd-control measures or minor disturbances. The interaction is not peaceful; it shows characteristics of collective unrest or violent group confrontation.

Large crowd of civilians and police in high-visibility vests engage in dynamic, chaotic movement across a paved area; officers advance and retreat, some individuals fall or are pushed to the ground, and there is visible pushing and shoving between groups, indicating violent unrest and group clashes rather than a peaceful gathering.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat observed: individuals in civilian clothing and uniformed officers are seen grappling, striking, and wrestling on the ground (e.g., two figures near center-right in f10–f12), consistent with hand-to-hand fighting.

At least one individual appears prone on the ground while being approached or acted upon by multiple officers; in f11–f13, a person lies motionless near the right curb while officers surround them, suggesting potential assault on a helpless victim.
